explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/743: 'Joos, Kim, Kühn, and Osthus proved that this conjecture holds when the trees have bounded maximum degree.' The Lean statement: for every d there is N such that for all n ≥ N and all trees T k (2 ≤ k ≤ n) with maxDegree ≤ d, the family packs into K_n. This is the standard quantification of the JKKO theorem (n large in terms of the degree bound). Faithful.
